query:
ALTER TABLE ab_test_experiments 
ADD COLUMN auto_decision_enabled INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT '是否启用自动决策(1=是, 0=否)',
ADD COLUMN decision_status ENUM('pending', 'ready_for_decision', 'decided', 'notified') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
ADD COLUMN decision_made_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '决策时间',
ADD COLUMN decision_recommendation ENUM('rollout_treatment', 'keep_control', 'needs_review', 'inconclusive') COMMENT '决策建议',
ADD COLUMN decision_reason TEXT COMMENT '决策理由',
ADD COLUMN decision_confidence FLOAT COMMENT '决策置信度(0-1)',
ADD COLUMN notification_sent_at TIMESTAMP NULL COMMENT '通知发送时间',
ADD COLUMN notification_recipients JSON COMMENT '通知接收人列表(JSON数组)',
ADD COLUMN min_sample_size INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 100 COMMENT '最小样本量',
ADD COLUMN significance_level FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.05 COMMENT '显著性水平(默认0.05)',
ADD COLUMN min_effect_size FLOAT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.05 COMMENT '最小效应量(默认5%提升)'
